## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0012 §6.1 隐私条把中继通用提示语的语言从「设备语言」改为「收件人的语言(`sys_user.locale`,其次部署默认)」;状态行加一条修订记录;「What `main` serves」条重新标明它所依据的代码版本(97e42498)。
- 为什么改:按 #29920 Q4 C 裁决,PR #30749 实际按收件人语言选这句提示语,ADR 原文与实现不一致;树钉是 PR #30749 契约复核 should-fix 1 留下的尾巴。
- 风险与回滚:纯 ADR 文字,一个文件 3 行,无代码、无行为改动;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md` 的 §6.1 隐私条(Privacy 那一条)和 Status 行末尾新增的 Amended 段。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n "device locale" docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md`,预期只剩修订记录里引用的旧措辞两处。
- 需要你做的:`docs/adr/**` 属 Tier H,席位 ACCEPT 后需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS(os-zhuang / hotlong)批准或你本人合并。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md`, three lines:

- **§6.1, privacy bullet:** the relay's generic visible line is chosen "in the recipient's language (`sys_user.locale`, then the deployment default)"; it read "in the device locale". This is what ruling Q4 C on #29920 decided and what PR #30749 ships (`resolveRecipientLocale` in `push-channel.ts`; the `text` describe in `push-relay.zod.ts` says "in the recipient's language"). The bullet ends with an italic amendment note quoting the replaced wording, in the form PR #30749 used.
- **§6.1, "What `main` serves" bullet:** the heading names its tree again, `objectstack-ai/objectstack at 97e42498, 2026-11-06` (the PR #30749 merge, the tree the bullet's reading describes). The heading PR #30749 replaced read "at 6a4737ab, 2026-11-03"; delta contract review 6674074177 on PR #30749, should-fix 1, carried in card note 6674101046.
- **Status line:** one `Amended (2026-11-06, #30670, on ruling Q4 C of #29920)` clause naming both edits and the wording each replaces.

No `scripts/adr-anchors/` row: anchors pin ADR ids in code files (`scripts/adr-anchors/README.md`), and this change touches no code.

## Tests

None owed: ADR prose only.

## Acceptance notes

- The tree pin names the merge commit 97e42498 rather than the current `main` head (2038c56e); the bullet's text landed with that merge and no later commit touched `service-push`, `cloud-binding.ts`, `push-relay.zod.ts` or this ADR.
